title: Law to set deadlines for approvals on small city projects
summary: This bill would require the Department of Design and Construction, working with other city agencies, to set timeframes for approving change orders and other decisions on capital projects costing $10 million or less. If an agency misses a deadline, it would have to give the contractor a written explanation within 10 days, including when it expects to act. The law would take effect one year after enactment.
